review_basis: Root opened each of the 11 final frame_post_draw PNG files at original production camera views. Independent bicycle reviewer also opened all 3 final bicycle PNGs. Numeric PASS alone was not used as image acceptance.

captures.name: bus_stop_open_doors
captures.finding: Blue body, both physical door openings/rails and the two-door E prompt are visible. Bench/shelter framing is partial.

captures.name: bus_moving_ride
captures.finding: Normal external ride camera shows the blue bus, authored shelter and a clean shared double-yellow median/white lanes. The seated model is largely occluded by the roof/windows; attachment is verified numerically, not inferred from this frame.

captures.name: bus_safe_exit
captures.finding: Player is on the supported second-stop pavement with the alighting-only prompt; the bus remains beside the curb.

captures.name: crossing_far_head_from_bank_1
captures.finding: Near-bank black back has no floating/reversed digits. Far-bank front shows green across the crossing; distant digits are small and the entrance HUD occupies part of the horizon.

captures.name: crossing_far_head_from_bank_0
captures.finding: Opposite bank has a readable green front direction; the near-bank opaque back stays dark. No mirrored countdown floats outside the case.

captures.name: dog_keeper_close
captures.finding: Dog head, torso, paws, tail and keeper/leash are now beside the player rather than behind the avatar. The ordinary view is still a few metres away, not a close anatomical inspection.

captures.name: crossing_wide
captures.finding: White zebra/stop lines and the single yellow central pair are separated, with no independent competing solid corridor edge through the visible lanes.

captures.name: crossing_pedestrian_green
captures.finding: Same crossing shows green walking signals on both bank orientations; small figures at distance are a remaining readability limit.

captures.name: warm_lamp_street_evening
captures.finding: The actual lamp-street location shows pole heads and a warm illuminated paving patch under evening light.

captures.name: warm_lamp_street_night
captures.finding: At the same location in night mode a warm paving pool is visible against cool darker pavement, with lamps/signals and cars in context. The avatar remains dark outside the spot centre.

captures.name: small_menu_640
captures.finding: The scroll container stays within the 640x480 viewport; later destinations are reached by scrolling. Text is naturally smaller at this size.

resolved: Competing road edges replaced by one paired central divider and owned directional markings
Reverse-facing pedestrian bank heads corrected; mirrored back-face floating countdown removed
Dog arrival look direction moved pair clear of avatar shoulder
Bike kickstand, fixed front/back station board and wrapped transport hint overlap fixed
limits: Far-head countdown text is small at cross-road distance; some entrance/name HUD panels cover parts of the view.
Bus external riding camera does not expose every interior or seated-body detail.
Some retained pedestrians are still simplified capsules; no crowd or appearance overhaul is claimed.
Still images do not establish temporal comfort or every animation contact frame.
Authored road furniture, signal timing, bus pilot and bike docks are not a surveyed/live traffic service.
